props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][TWIN-SHIELD]";

const DEF_MASTERY_BASE_UUID = "Item.fJshVRdauYDSTAop";

const DEF_MASTERY_ID = DEF_MASTERY_BASE_UUID.split(".").pop();

const p =

(typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD)

? __PAYLOAD

: (typeof payload !== "undefined" && payload)

? payload

: null;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const normalize = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

async function safeFromUuid(uuid) {

const s = String(uuid ?? "").trim();

if (!s) return null;

try {

return await fromUuid(s);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "fromUuid failed.", {

uuid: s,

error: String(err?.message ?? err)

});

return null;

}

}

function coerceActorFromDoc(doc) {

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor" || doc.constructor?.name === "Actor") {

return doc;

}

if (doc.actor) return doc.actor;

if (doc.object?.actor) return doc.object.actor;

if (doc.token?.actor) return doc.token.actor;

if (doc.parent?.actor) return doc.parent.actor;

if (doc.document?.actor) return doc.document.actor;

return null;

}

async function resolveAttackerActorPermissionSafe() {

// Preferred path: use CustomLogic-Action helper.

// This is safest because it already understands token UUID → actor resolution.

try {

if (context?.helpers?.getAttackerActor) {

const actor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (actor) return actor;

}

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "context.helpers.getAttackerActor failed; falling back.", {

error: String(err?.message ?? err)

});

}

// Fallback path: resolve from payload UUIDs.

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.meta?.sourceActorUuid ??

p?.sourceActorUuid ??

p?.actorUuid ??

null;

const doc = await safeFromUuid(attackerUuid);

return coerceActorFromDoc(doc);

}

function canReadActor(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

if (game.user?.isGM) return true;

try {

if (actor.isOwner === true) return true;

const levels = CONST?.DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_LEVELS ?? {};

const observerLevel = levels.OBSERVER ?? "OBSERVER";

const ownerLevel = levels.OWNER ?? "OWNER";

if (actor.testUserPermission?.(game.user, ownerLevel)) return true;

if (actor.testUserPermission?.(game.user, observerLevel)) return true;

if (actor.testUserPermission?.(game.user, "OWNER")) return true;

if (actor.testUserPermission?.(game.user, "OBSERVER")) return true;

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "Actor permission check failed.", {

actor: actor?.name ?? null,

user: game.user?.name ?? null,

error: String(err?.message ?? err)

});

}

return false;

}

const attackerActor = await resolveAttackerActorPermissionSafe();

if (!attackerActor) {

return context.cancelPipeline("Twin Shield: missing attacker actor.");

}

if (!canReadActor(attackerActor)) {

return context.cancelPipeline(

`Twin Shield: ${game.user?.name ?? "current user"} cannot read attacker actor "${attackerActor.name}".`

);

}

const getUuidCandidates = (item) => {

return [

item?.uuid,

item?.id,

item?._id,

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "sourceId"),

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "flags.core.sourceId"),

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "_stats.compendiumSource"),

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "flags.core.uuid")

]

.filter(Boolean)

.map(String);

};

const matchesDefensiveMasteryByUuid = (item) => {

const candidates = getUuidCandidates(item);

return candidates.some((u) =>

u === DEF_MASTERY_BASE_UUID ||

u.endsWith(DEF_MASTERY_BASE_UUID) ||

u.endsWith(`.${DEF_MASTERY_ID}`) ||

u.includes(`.${DEF_MASTERY_ID}`)

);

};

const readSkillLevel = (item) => {

const raw =

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "level") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "system.level") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(item, "system.props.level") ??

0;

const n = Number(raw);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, n) : 0;

};

const actorItems = Array.from(attackerActor.items ?? []);

// 1) Prefer UUID/source UUID match

let defensiveMastery =

actorItems.find((it) => matchesDefensiveMasteryByUuid(it)) ?? null;

// 2) Fallback: case-insensitive name match

if (!defensiveMastery) {

defensiveMastery =

actorItems.find((it) => normalize(it?.name) === "defensive mastery") ?? null;

}

const sl = defensiveMastery ? readSkillLevel(defensiveMastery) : 0;

const bonusBefore = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + sl;

p.meta.twinShield = {

defensiveMasteryFound: !!defensiveMastery,

defensiveMasteryItemName: defensiveMastery?.name ?? null,

defensiveMasterySL: sl,

permissionSafe: true,

executionUser: {

id: game.user?.id ?? null,

name: game.user?.name ?? null,

isGM: !!game.user?.isGM

}

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

user: game.user?.name ?? null,

isGM: !!game.user?.isGM,

attacker: attackerActor.name,

defensiveMasteryFound: !!defensiveMastery,

defensiveMasteryItemName: defensiveMastery?.name ?? null,

defensiveMasterySL: sl,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

props.description:
Your maximum Hit Points are permanently increased by an amount equal to your base Insight die size (update your maximum HP if this size changes).

When a conflict scene begins, if you have learned the Divination spell, you gain 1 Prophecy Point. You also gain 1 Prophecy Point at the start of each even-numbered round (regardless of whether you have learned Divination). You lose all Prophecy Points at the end of each scene.

When one or more allies are threatened by a single attack, spell, or other danger, you may spend 1 Prophecy Point to take the place of all those allies (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill before or after the Checks have been made). The danger will affect you once for each creature it was threatening (including yourself, if you were among those creatures). Resolve each of these instances separately.
